name: The Naked Director
description: Follows the rise of Tooru Muranishi, one of Japan's most notorious directors of adult video.  Adapted from a biography of the man, this series depicts the character, his art, vision and his interactions with the approving and disapproving folk around him.

videos.title: The Hidden Side
videos.overview: After another month of lackluster encyclopedia sales, Muranishi's job is on the line. But just when he starts making money, his life falls apart.

videos.title: Uncensored
videos.overview: Muranishi and Toshi move onto selling porn magazines, starting their own bookstore chain in Hokkaido. But their success attracts unwanted attention.

videos.title: Shake Things Up
videos.overview: After living on the lam in Tokyo, Muranishi and Toshi are arrested in Sapporo. Once they get out, they reunite with Kawada with a new goal: video.

videos.title: The Real Thing
videos.overview: Furuya tells the Sapphire team that Ikezawa and Takei are working together. Muranishi recruits a Poseidon actress for their next video.

videos.title: Blossoming
videos.overview: Blacklisted by Ikezawa and squeezed by the regulatory commission, Sapphire nears bankruptcy. After confronting her mother, Megumi seeks out Muranishi.

videos.title: Delusions of Grandeur
videos.overview: Muranishi takes his crew to Hawaii for an ambitious make-or-break shoot with Allison, a famous American porn star. Toshi goes to Furuya for help.

videos.title: Don't Dream It's Over
videos.overview: Facing a 370-year prison term, Muranishi 100 million yen to make bail. While Toshi and Kawada struggle to raise funds, Kaoru demands to help out.

videos.title: A Sexual Revolution
videos.overview: Back in Japan, the Showa era is ending and Kaoru Kuroki has become a sensation. Sapphire and Poseidon are cranking out videos, but a crackdown looms.

videos.title: Sex Will Come Raining Down
videos.overview: The year is 1990, and Muranishi is riding high. When his investment banker introduces him to the concept of satellite TV, he finds his next big thing.

videos.title: More, More, More
videos.overview: To raise money for a satellite channel, Muranishi starts cranking out videos and pushing boundaries, but he ends up neglecting Kaoru, his biggest star.

videos.title: Diamond in the Rough
videos.overview: Sapphire Pictures is rebranded into the more upscale Diamond Visual. A shy woman named Miyuki responds to a casting call and winds up shadowing Kaoru.

videos.title: Our Dream
videos.overview: Kaoru enthusiastically promotes her upcoming video. Umino finally gives his response regarding the satellite deal. Miyuki is nervous about her debut.

videos.title: The Bubble Bursts
videos.overview: Muranishi gives Miyuki a new name: Mariko Nogi. But Diamond is running out of money, and as the bubble economy bursts, they have to find new revenue.

videos.title: Out of Control
videos.overview: While the Diamond staff fumes, Muranishi desperately searches for a way to make the next satellite payment and keep the business afloat.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Kaoru is hospitalized. Inspired by industry changes, Wada recruits Toshi, Kawada and Mitamura to make videos for his chain. Muranishi's debt comes due.

videos.title: The Will of a Stone
videos.overview: Toshi takes matters with the yakuza into his own hands. The other Diamond staff members slowly move on with their lives.
